0|2d51eb0bd81cfbafc762592ede9e9234063cc853|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"bnxt_en: Add MSIX check in bnxt_check_rings()
bnxt_check_rings() is called to ensure that we have the hardware ring
resources before committing to reinitialize with the new number of
rings.  MSIX vectors are never checked at this point
until recently we must first disable MSIX before we can allocate the
new set of MSIX vectors.
Now that we support dynamic MSIX allocation
can dynamically allocate the new MSIX vectors as the last step in
bnxt_check_rings() if dynamic MSIX is supported.
For example
column2: the IOMMU group may limit the number of MSIX vectors

column1: for the device.  With this patch
column2: the ring change will fail more

column1: gracefully when there is not enough MSIX vectors.
It is also better to move bnxt_check_rings() to be called as the last
step when changing ethtool rings.
